end.summary:
Predicted that curved surfaces roll in 6 of 7 unaided attempts.
Predicted that flat faces slide in 2 of 2 attempts.
Identified that the same object can roll one way and stand or stack another way.
The idea that only balls can roll was noted and was not marked corrected after its last occurrence.
end.parentNote: Asha practised sorting objects by curved and flat surfaces, including rolling, sliding, and stacking. Anika used examples such as laddoos, drums, bottles, glasses, boxes, and blocks, and explained that boxes can stack into a tower. There was a mix-up that only balls can roll; it was not marked as corrected after its last occurrence. At home, try gently rolling a bottle or glass on its side, then stand it up and discuss which surface touches the table.
